svg.text: GHOSTED: Juno the barista, body map v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Decided before the sheet: proportions in head-heights, landmarks, attachment points (puff, scrunchie, apron bib, straps, tie, bow, cup, marker), and a check at the game camera (26 m, pitch 42).
A. FRONT (upright, symmetric)
top of the puff y 10
top of the hair cap y 52
hairline (centre) y 64
temple hair (lowest) y 84
eye line = ear points y 104
mouth y 130
chin y 154
neckline y 162
shoulder joint (arm root) y 186
chest = bib top y 196
cup (rest, held) y 224
waist = apron tie y 238
hem y 294
sole y 340
1 head
B. SIDE and BACK (same lines)
C. THE CUP and the HOLDS (front, x2.2 crops)
Cup: tapered cylinder, 26 wide x 34 tall + lid. Ball hands hold it from the sides or under it.
rest: two hands
hand over: on the palm
write: cup up, marker
PROPORTIONS (head = top of the puff to the chin = 144 units)
Whole figure 330 units = 2.29 heads; without the puff
2.82 heads (Kit 2.71, Ricky 2.67, Brett 2.53, Dot 2.27).
Size: 1.0 x Kit on screen = 75 px, puff included;
estimate 1.12 m to the puff top (1 u = 3.41 mm).
Skull 108 wide, 96 tall (y 58-154). Puff 72 wide, 60 tall.
Body: an HOURGLASS. 120 wide at the shoulder (y 186),
82 at the apron tie (y 238), 134 at the hem (y 294).
Depth 0.8 of the width.
LANDMARKS
Hairline: high and clean, y 64 at the centre, y 84-88 at
the head sides, in front of the ears. Hair pulled back:
2 strand lines ON the hair sweep up to the puff.
Forehead band (magenta bracket): hairline 64 to brow 86.
Eye line y 104; eyes x 132 / 168 (ink ovals + glint).
Ears: on the eye line at the head sides (x 96 / 204).
Mouth zone x 138-162, y 122-140. Rest: a closed smile
line. Laugh / talk: Ricky style (dark fill, teeth band).
Neck: chin y 154, round neckline y 162.
Shoulder joint x 96 / 204, y 186. Sleeves rolled to the
elbow (brown cuff), skin forearms, ball hands.
ATTACHMENT POINTS (magenta)
Puff: centred on the head axis, top-back (centre y 40,
z -18). Scrunchie: a red ring at its base, y 62.
Bib: from the chest y 198 to the tie, straps up to the
neckline. Skirt apron: tie y 242 to the hem, red pocket.
Apron tie: a red cord round the waist y 238; the bow
and two tails at the BACK, centred (as a real apron).
Cup: in her hands. Rest: centred in front of the apron,
y 224. The marker: in her right hand, writing only.
E. GAME CAMERA CHECK (x3; 1x at right). Left: Juno estimate. Middle: landmark dots (blue: eyes, mouth, hairline, ears, neck, hands, hem, feet;
magenta: puff, scrunchie, bib, tie, bow (hidden at the back), cup). Right: Kit, real v7 render. Net yaw 5 (lineup facing), pitch 42.
Forehead band at 1x (hairline edge to brow top): 6.4 px (left brow), 6.7 px (centre), 6.4 px (right brow). Rule: 4 px or more.
Temples: the lowest side hair (y 88.0) is 7.1 px ABOVE the eye top, outside the eye columns. Nothing on the forehead, nothing down beside the eyes.
Mouth at 1x: the closed smile is 5.1 x 0.8 px, 2.9 px below the eyes; the laugh (Ricky style) 7.2 x 2.2 px.
Height: 75 x 43 px (target 75, puff included). Kit is 75 px.
Read: a dark round puff with a red ring, a peach face with two eyes and a small smile, a dark-brown
hourglass with an apricot apron front, a red tie at the waist, a white cup in both hands, navy legs.
